transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the courtyard set review. We've got two options on the table — a masonry courtyard or a modular painted-timber build — and we need to settle on a construction plan that fits within the $180,000 budget so fabrication can begin after this review. I'd like to hear from each of your departments before I make a final decision. Structural, permits, stunt, and insurance — what do you have for us?

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical structural issue before we go further. My load test yesterday found that the masonry courtyard option would exceed Soundstage 3's 600 kilograms-per-square-meter floor limit. The modular painted-timber design does pass, but only if we install a 30-millimeter load-spreading deck. My written report is still in the engineering queue, so I want to make sure everyone hears this directly from me now.
